title: Discovery of novel selective PI3Kγ inhibitors through combining machine learning-based virtual screening with multiple protein structures and bio-evaluation
summary: Multi-structure machine-learning virtual screening selected PI3Kγ inhibitor JN-KI3 from a large chemical library. Enzymatic assays found selective PI3Kγ inhibition and cancer-cell assays reported selective cytotoxicity in hematologic cell lines; these experiments support an in-study discovery, not clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: Machine-learning virtual screening across multiple protein structures prioritized PI3Kγ inhibitor JN-KI3.
organization: School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Jiangnan University, Wuxi, Jiangsu 214122, China

evidence.tested: Virtual screening identified JN-KI3; cell-free enzyme assays reported selective PI3Kγ inhibition and cell assays reported selective cytotoxicity in hematologic cancer lines.
evidence.unknown: These assays were conducted within the discovery study; in-vivo therapeutic benefit and clinical efficacy were not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning virtual screening across multiple protein structures prioritized PI3Kγ inhibitor JN-KI3.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
